gse244832.allowed_use: Future descriptive transductive unpaired integration only. RNA and ATAC aliquots must be separate batches with None in the other modality.
gse244832.model_access: Because scMoMaT must optimize coordinates for supplied cells, it cannot treat GSE244832 as a held external evaluation while also embedding it.

gse289173.allowed_use: None. Optimizing sealed-cell coordinates or including sealed RNA in a transductive factorization is prohibited.
gse289173.model_access: No features, labels, outcomes, or transductive coordinate fitting.

gse296875.allowed_use: Future descriptive same-nucleus and mosaic integration diagnostics only after activation gates and a nonpromotable TaskSpec.
gse296875.model_access: All included donor cells are fitted coordinates. Results cannot be called held-donor inductive performance.

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; distinct modality batches and None placeholders
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; parallel matrices allowed only after exact ordered row-ID validation
pairing_rules.gse289173: RNA_only sealed rows are excluded entirely

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; optimized cell factors are not independent replicates.
rules.feature_contract: All batches in a modality share an identical ordered training/development feature inventory. Peak remapping cannot use a held evaluation source.
rules.no_champion: A transductive scMoMaT result is descriptive and cannot earn a sealed champion claim.
rules.preprocessing: Quantile normalization, maximum scaling, graph post-processing, clustering, and any marker retraining are fitted only within the declared descriptive analysis population.
